Clairix / Brand book 2.0 / Acid Stencil

Nothing hides.

Clairix is counter-surveillance you’d actually wear. It finds hidden cameras, trackers following you, fake cell towers, rogue Wi-Fi and spyware, and keeps your calls and messages private.

The brand looks like it belongs on a hoodie and talks like a friend who knows security: confident, direct, a little attitude, and always clear about what to do next.

01 / Mark

C locks the X.

The X is the thing that was hiding: the camera, the tracker, the spyware. The C closes around it. One stencil slit cuts straight through, like light through a visor.

  1. Octagon CCut corners at 24% of the width. Tactical, not round. The same chamfer appears in tags, badges and buttons.
  2. The XTwo straight bars with flat terminals, always in acid green. The only colour in the logo.
  3. The slitOne horizontal cut through the C’s spine. In the wordmark it runs through every letter, and in the lockup the two cuts line up into one.
  4. The mouthOpens to the right with slanted cuts that pass exactly through the counter’s corners. Open, not broken.
02 / Logo

Lockups and versions

Light on dark is the primary logo. Use the horizontal lockup by default, the stacked lockup in tall spaces, and the mark alone where the name is already known: icon, patch, avatar.

The mark on Ink, every theme, every time. On Android it is an adaptive icon: the mark is 50 dp wide and all its corners sit inside the 66 dp safe circle. The themed (monochrome) layer uses the same shapes.

03 / Space and size

Room to breathe

Clear space is one C: the thickness of the C’s stroke, 23% of the mark’s height. Keep it clear on every side of every version. On merch, double it.

04 / Misuse

Don’t touch it

The logo is drawn to the unit. Use the files as supplied.

05 / Themes

One brand, four themes

People pick the colour theme in the app. Acid is the default and the brand’s own colour. Infrared, Hazard and Volt change the interface colours only: the logo, the app icon and all marketing stay Acid.

Dark only, by design. The four accents are neon-bright: on white they fall to 1.1-3:1 contrast and lose their identity, so a light mode would need a second, muted brand. The app and all brand surfaces are dark. Every theme defines the same 31 roles, and the token build fails if any text pair drops below 4.5:1.

06 / Type

Archivo, wide and normal

One family, two widths. Archivo Expanded shouts in headlines and on merch; Archivo at normal width does the reading. They share one skeleton, so the loud parts and the quiet parts always match. Archivo was built for screen and print, has sturdy open shapes and clear figures at 12 to 14 px, and it is SIL Open Font License, so the app, site and merch use the same files.

Aa.

Archivo Expanded · ExtraBold, Black

Display, headlines, big numbers, labels. Always capitals. Width 125.

Aa

Archivo · 400 to 700

Body, buttons, lists, settings. Sentence case. Width 100.

Aa

JetBrains Mono

Machine values only: MAC addresses, cell IDs, fingerprints.

07 / Voice

Talk like you’ve got this

Confident, direct, a little attitude. The attitude lives in headlines and taglines. Instructions stay plain and calm, because the person reading them might be scared. We never use fear to sell, and we are never mean.

Primary tagline
Nothing hides.
  • See it first.
  • Check the room.
  • Found. Flagged. Handled.
  • Your phone answers to you.
  • Watch the watchers.

Principles

Confident

We know this stuff, so we say it straight. No hedging, no jargon walls.

Direct

Short sentences. What happened, what it means, what to do. Then stop.

Some attitude

We’re on your side, against whoever is watching. A little swagger, never smug.

Clear

Plain words. “Tracker”, not “BLE beacon”. Details are a tap away.

No fear

No panic, no all-caps alarms, no “act now or else”. Calm people act better.

Never mean

We never shame, blame or label people. We name the device, not the person.

We say / Not this

Tracker following
Tracker on you. Seen in 3 places over 40 minutes. Make it ring to find it.
SOMEONE IS STALKING YOU!!!
Room is clear
Room’s clear. Nothing hiding here. Scan again if you switch rooms.
You’re 100% safe. Unhackable.
Keylogger keyboard
This keyboard reads every key you press. Swap it out in 2 taps.
You’ve been hacked. Your life is exposed.
Fake cell tower
Sketchy cell tower nearby. Your Clairix calls stay encrypted.
IMSI catcher detected! Calls intercepted!
Panic wipe
Wipe Clairix data now? There’s no undo.
Burn it all and disappear.
Pro upsell
Pro scans in the background. You get on with your day.
Upgrade or stay exposed.

Words

We use
  • found
  • flagged
  • clear
  • locked
  • check
  • swap
  • on you
  • nearby
  • yours
  • handled
We avoid
  • you’ve been hacked
  • victim
  • stalker (for a person)
  • 100% secure
  • unhackable
  • military-grade
  • paranoid
  • act now
  • threat actor

Rules

  • Attitude up top, clarity below. Headline can swagger; the instruction under it is calm and exact.
  • Capitals only in display type and labels. Never in alerts or body text.
  • One exclamation mark per year. Ideally zero.
  • Buttons are verbs: Scan room, Find it, Swap keyboard, Wipe now.
  • Numbers as digits: 40 minutes, 3 places, 2 taps.
  • Never promise total safety. We say what we found and what we checked.
08 / Merch

Built to be worn

Merch is where the brand gets loud. Black garments first, bone and acid ink, the slit always intact.

Screen printBone ink (match #EFF3EB) and fluorescent green for the X (start from Pantone 802 C, approve against #C8FF24 by drawdown). Max 2 colours plus garment.
EmbroideryMark only, 25 mm minimum, slit at least 1 mm. Two thread colours. Below 25 mm use the one-colour mark.
PlacementChest, left chest (mark, 7 cm), back yoke (wordmark, 28 cm) or sleeve (wordmark running down, 4 cm high). Keep 2C clear space on fabric.

Everything is generated from source. Change the source and rebuild; never edit outputs by hand.
